scientific_integrity: Four-time connected cumulants are analytically integrated; 193 deterministic checks are finite consistency tests and not infinite proofs; source-model results are credited. Publication priority and proof have not been independently audited.
scientific_limitations: Stationary unrepelled harmonic dimer; independent asymmetry and relative-position processes; exact covariance matching; a,b,A,B>0; no repulsive interactions, kinetic sampling error estimates or arbitrary nonreciprocal couplings.
title: Identical mean-squared displacements but strictly different fourth cumulants in active Brownian dimers
